item.title: Regression
item.description: (or “How Should I Dress Today?”) Last week, we saw how to determine whether 2 things appear to be related or not, using correlation. But, just being aware that variables are correlated isn’t always that useful on its own. “THIS JUST IN - CLOUDS ARE CORRELATED TO RAIN.” In many cases, it would be very nice to know HOW MUCH one factor affects the other. Using a technique called regression, we can do just this.
